description: Normalized HF transport dataset for Cu, Al, Ag, and Fe.

cu.source_title: Frequency Dependence Measuring of Skin-Effect on Metal Wires with Different Materials and Diameters

al.source_title: Frequency Dependence Measuring of Skin-Effect on Metal Wires with Different Materials and Diameters

ag.source_title: Study of the skin depth in different metallic atoms

fe.source_title: Comparison of Skin Effects in Ferromagnetic and Nonferromagnetic Materials

notes: The numerical series are normalised, derived tables with explicit provenance.
Cu and Al reuse the measured-wire source identified in validation notes.
Ag uses the published skin-depth paper with DOI 10.1016/j.matpr.2020.12.715.
Fe uses a ferromagnetic skin-effect source with an explicit effective permeability assumption in the JSON record.
